description.p: Grimoire is an addon manager for The Elder Scrolls Online. Browse, install, and update addons from ESOUI.com with automatic dependency resolution. Works on Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck.

ul.li: Browse and search the full ESOUI addon catalogue
One-click install with automatic dependency handling
Backup and restore your AddOns and SavedVariables

description.p: Fix white screen and "cannot connect to localhost" on Linux.

ul.li: Set WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 before WebKit init to fix white screen in AppImage on many Linux GPU setups.
Add WEBKIT_DISABLE_WEB_PROCESS_SANDBOX=1 to Flatpak finish-args so the tauri:// custom URI scheme handler is reachable from WebKit's sandboxed web process.
